bug.title: The agent_sampling record contract cannot describe a model that takes no sampling parameters, so honest provenance for claude-opus-5-5 / claude-sonnet-5-5 is unrepresentable
bug.symptoms: providers._sampling (feature 204) requires exactly the keys temperature, top_p, thinking and seed, with temperature and top_p numbers, thinking a bool and seed a non-null int, and refuses unknown keys. For claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 the backend sends no temperature or top_p (the vendor rejects them), thinking is adaptive, and the configured effort is sent as output_config.effort. Satisfying the current contract would mean recording a temperature and top_p the vendor never received, and the only alternative, recording the effort, is refused as an unknown key.
bug.reproduction_steps: providers.AgentSampling.from_json('{"effort":"high"}') and AgentSampling(temperature=None, top_p=None, thinking="adaptive", seed=0) both refuse.
bug.expected: - The record keeps its four required keys and gains one optional key: - temperature: a number in [0, MAX_TEMPERATURE], or null meaning "not sent; the model's own default applied". - top_p: a number in (0, 1], or null with the same meaning. - thinking: a bool, or the string "adaptive". - seed: unchanged (non-null int in [0, SEED_MAX]). - effort (optional): one of low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Present only when an effort was sent. Any other key is still refused. - Every record valid before this change parses unchanged and renders to the identical canonical JSON. DEFAULT_SAMPLING is unchanged. - The refusal messages name the extended rule, never claim a key is mandatory when it is optional, and keep the feature-204 wording that a missing required key is refused. - test_sampling.py gains tests for: - a null temperature and null top_p - thinking "adaptive" - each effort level, and an unknown effort refused - an extra unknown key still refused - a pre-change record that round-trips byte-identically
bug.actual: Root cause: feature 204 fixed the record to four numeric/bool settings before any model rejected sampling parameters; feature 5 of additions_spec_real_campaign_path.xml added effort and no-sampling models without extending the record.
bug.constraints: Backward compatible: every existing stored agent_sampling value stays valid and byte-identical in canonical form No migration (the column is JSON text and already NOT NULL) No file outside the two listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/

bug.title: The signal author records agent_sampling={"effort": ...} alone, which node persistence refuses, so a real campaign on claude-opus-5-5 stops after its first root
bug.symptoms: `./run.sh campaign --type Type-R --workspaces 4 --rounds 2 --width 2` with pins on claude-opus-5-5 / claude-sonnet-5-5, "temperature": null and "effort": "high" authored one root (node b5b34d5e…, theme borrow-rate-conditioning, agent_sampling '{"effort":"high"}'), then exited 1 with "an agent_sampling record is missing ['temperature', 'top_p', 'thinking', 'seed']…". signal_agent/_llm_author.py (~line 648) builds the record as {"effort": self._config.effort}.
bug.reproduction_steps: Run the campaign CLI over tests/e2e/test_real_data_campaign_e2e.py's offline setup with an authoring config of temperature null, effort high and a 5.x pin: the first root's record is refused on persistence.
bug.expected: - The signal author records the full extended record for what was actually sent: - temperature: null when none was sent, else the number - top_p: null when none was sent - thinking: "adaptive" for models that think adaptively (the 5.x family), else the bool actually configured - seed: as today - effort: when one was sent The record validates against bug 1's contract on every path (root, child, retry). - tests/e2e/test_real_data_campaign_e2e.py runs its offline campaign with the current real configuration: pins on claude-opus-5-5 (roots) and claude-sonnet-5-5 (depth), temperature null, effort high. The campaign completes. Each persisted node's agent_sampling equals {"effort":"high","seed":…,"temperature":null,"thinking":"adaptive","top_p":null}, and the recorded fixture's request bodies carry output_config.effort and no temperature. This is the regression guard for all three wiring bugs found that day. - test_llm_author_sampling.py asserts the full record on all three call sites.
bug.actual: Root cause: bug_spec_effort_wiring.xml bug 1 replaced the record with {"effort": …} instead of extending it, and the e2e test that should have caught it authors with a temperature-bearing config.
bug.constraints: No file outside the three listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
